{{Top|leg}}
'''Flex-carpet''' was a unique form of carpeting developed sometime between [[4 ABY/Legends|4]] and [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]]. It had an advanced internal heating system, and was most commonly found in upscale buildings on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The heated areas could be arranged in different configurations along the floor to create a warm, walking pathway.
